title: Fix the Stuck Binary Search
description: The program should search for a target value in a sorted array using binary search.
expectedBehavior: The program should print 3, the index of 7 in the array.
actualProblem: When narrowing the range, low is set to mid instead of mid + 1, and high is set to mid instead of mid - 1. Since mid can be recomputed to the same value again on the next iteration, the search range never actually shrinks, causing an infinite loop.
explanation: Each half of a binary search must strictly exclude the already-checked middle index (mid + 1 or mid - 1), or the search range stops shrinking and the loop never terminates.
